thread:
Maria G.: Quick q — for the SLO/bench slides, should we report p95/p99 from prod-trace replay or from synthetic Poisson/stress curves? Microbatch sizing flips the story and the PR is getting noisy.

Kevin L.: Replay gives more realistic tails because of correlated bursts + KV warmup, but only if the trace is properly sanitized and we preserve concurrency. Synthetic is great for controlled knobs.

Anya (ML): +1 to Kevin. Also: split queuing vs service latency in the tables. p99 often ends up being queueing when microbatch max=8.

Sam T.: Can we just publish both? baseline = real-timings replay (sanitized prod trace) + synthetic sweeps (rps sweep, step load). Plot p50/p95/p99/p999 and batch-occupancy histograms.

Maria G.: OK. How long should the replay run be? KV cache needs warm time, right?

Kevin L.: Recommend >=1 hour for a representative trace so KV cache and kernel selection paths stabilize. Also record per-token KV hit-rate. For synthetic stress tests use shorter runs but multiple seeds.

Anya (ML): Also record which kernel was chosen per request (eg `fast_gemm` vs `stable_int8`) and the batch packing depth. Sampled CPU/GPU flamegraphs (1% sampled) to help track regressions.

Sam T.: For microbatch policy, let's standardize on: min_batch=1, max_batch=8, timeout_ms=20 for the labs. That reproduces typical PLG traffic. We should also sweep max_batch in the synthetic runs.

Maria G.: Nice. Can you paste the replay command & config we should use?

Kevin L.: Sure — example:

```
# replay with preserved inter-arrival times
./perf/replay --trace=sanitized_trace_v2.json --rate=real --duration=3600 \
  --concurrency=auto --record-metrics=s3://perf-artifacts/1748881234/
```

And synthetic stress:

```
./perf/stress --mode=poisson --rps=200 --burst=5 --seed=42 --duration=600
```

Include config snippet for batching: `{"min_batch":1,"max_batch":8,"batch_wait_ms":20}`

Maria G.: Perfect. I'll add those to the PR.

Sam T.: For regression detection we should: store raw latency samples, compute CDFs, alert on KS-test p<0.01 OR p99 delta > 10% absolute. Also track tail-ratio = p999/p95.

Anya (ML): + track KV-hit-rate and kernel-switch counts per minute. When we saw the last regression the kernel selector picked a slower int8 fallback during high seq-len bursts.

perf-bot: Experiment recorded: id=1748881200, trace=sanitized_trace_v2.json, mode=replay (real-timings), target=120rps, duration=3600s, p50=28ms, p95=82ms, p99=240ms, p999=640ms, KV_hit_rate=0.62. Artifacts: s3://ci-perf/1748881200/

Maria G.: Great — I'll attach artifacts + scripts in the PR and ask infra to run the synthetic sweep on perf-circle. @Kevin L. @Anya (ML) can you review when I open it? :+1:
